result.title: The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression
result.summary: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究迭代随机 ridge 回归中「重用同一 sketch」与「每步重抽新 sketch」的差异，证明新鲜 sketch 只在当前残差方向上分析误差即可获得更紧的收敛保证，并据此提出残差感知采样与 oracle 分布的近似，且在合成数据与 Qwen2.5 表征的 ridge probe 上验证收敛更快。
AI.relevance_reason: 残差感知采样、每步重抽随机性与「沿当前残差方向」而非全 Gram 矩阵统一分析误差的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态随推理步更新时的采样/近似策略提供借鉴，但需核查其线性回归设定与 VLM 推理状态之间的迁移边界。
